assessments.reasoning: The four verified publisher ranges establish the source material and grant condition. Section 3.4 supplies both the substantive preservation rule and the limited correction permission in the same passage.

limitations: The notice’s location, its substance, the known error, and the extent of the necessary correction matter. Section 3.4 addresses notices contained in covered source.
reasoning: Section 3.4 protects the substance of license notices within covered source, including copyright and patent notices, warranty disclaimers, and liability limitations. It permits alteration to the extent required to correct a known factual inaccuracy. Section 2.7 makes observance a condition of the section 2.1 grants.
